storageSaveNew.summary: Starts an asynchronous write to a new RAM file and refuses replacement of an existing file.
storageSaveNew.returns: Write reference; wait for completion before reading.
prerequisites: Import Storage and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use save … as …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Starts an asynchronous write to a new RAM file and refuses replacement of an existing file. Write reference; wait for completion before reading.

examples.title: Save before reading
examples.code:
set write to (save [hello] as [/RAM/example.txt])
wait for file write [write]
read text [/RAM/example.txt]
examples.explanation: Use a new filename. A completed write reads back hello. RAM files disappear after reboot or power loss.

notes: RAM files are temporary: they survive Stop All and reconnect, but disappear on reboot or power loss. Eight files, each at most 8192 bytes. Use paths such as /RAM/note.txt. Simple ASCII names and up to four virtual directory components; no hidden names, .., backslashes or URL escapes. Save returns a write reference: wait for that write before reading. Replace must be true to overwrite. Stop All cancels unfinished writes and preserves completed files. One pending write; cancellation only works before commit. Read text requires UTF-8 without NUL; read bytes preserves arbitrary binary data. Flash and SD are unavailable. This stage handles small records, not full camera/audio archives. No web file manager yet. New firmware required; host tests/builds and disconnected UI are separate from physical verification.
Source: integration\Storage.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
